description: This file defines an Angular component called TopNavComponent, which implements the top navigation bar with brand display, search, action buttons, and user dropdown. It includes methods to toggle the sidebar, open/close the user dropdown, and handle dropdown actions, serving as part of the UI layout.

classes.name: TopNavComponent
classes.description: An Angular component representing the top navigation bar, capable of toggling sidebar and user dropdown, and handling user actions.

methods.name: toggleSidebar
methods.description: Emits an event to toggle (collapse/expand) the sidebar in the parent component.

methods.name: toggleDropdown
methods.description: Toggles the visibility state of the user account dropdown menu.

methods.name: closeDropdown
methods.description: Closes the user account dropdown menu.

methods.name: onDropdownAction
methods.description: Handles actions from the dropdown menu, such as navigating to settings or logging out (currently logs messages).
